lessons.title: Create your first character
lessons.brief: Use create-character with an identity record to make a project. The check passes when the project carries its consent record: an adult character who wants the scenes selected for them, recorded in the project itself.

lessons.title: Know your states
lessons.brief: States are named parameter recipes stored in the project. The check passes when any stored state composes in the preview without error — apply one and watch the parameters move.

lessons.title: Cover the governed expressions
lessons.brief: Every governed expression of this pack needs a state implementing it. The check passes when no governed expression is missing from the project's states.

lessons.title: Tracking basics: the standard face set
lessons.brief: The face-standard tracking set is the tracker's contract for face and torso. The check passes when the rig carries every ID of the set within its declared ranges.

lessons.title: Pass the export gate
lessons.brief: A character is not done until it exports. The check passes when the project builds the native lumen-rig-model with no refusal.

lessons.title: Capstone: a complete character
lessons.brief: Everything at once: the project validates clean, carries its consent record, covers every governed expression, and exports. Pass this and the Characters track is complete.
